# ANOVA {#sec-anova}

{{< include ../preamble.qmd >}}

## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}

## Formal {.unnumbered}

$$
    F = \frac{MS_{Treatments}}{MS_{Error}} = \frac{\frac{\sum_j^k n_j (\bar{X_j} - \bar{X})^2}{k - 1}}{\frac{\sum_j \sum (X - \bar{X_j})^2}{N - k}}
$${#eq-anova}

## Examples {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "One-way ANOVA Analysis"
#| label: fig-anova-analysis

# Create sample data with multiple groups
set.seed(789)
group_a <- rnorm(30, mean = 50, sd = 5)
group_b <- rnorm(30, mean = 55, sd = 5)
group_c <- rnorm(30, mean = 52, sd = 5)

# Combine into a data frame
anova_data <- data.frame(
  values = c(group_a, group_b, group_c),
  group = rep(c("Group A", "Group B", "Group C"), each = 30)
)

# Run one-way ANOVA
anova_result <- aov(values ~ group, data = anova_data)
print("ANOVA Summary:")
print(summary(anova_result))

# Extract ANOVA table
anova_table <- summary(anova_result)[[1]]
print("\nANOVA Table:")
print(anova_table)

# Interpretation:
# If p-value > 0.05: we fail to reject H0 (group means are not significantly different)
# If p-value < 0.05: we reject H0 (at least one group mean is significantly different)

# Get descriptive statistics by group
print("\nDescriptive Statistics by Group:")
print(aggregate(values ~ group, data = anova_data, FUN = function(x) c(mean = mean(x), sd = sd(x), n = length(x))))
```

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "ANOVA Visualizations: Boxplot and Group Means"
#| label: fig-anova-plots

# Set up 1x2 panel layout
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

# Panel 1: Boxplot
boxplot(values ~ group, data = anova_data,
        main = "Boxplot: Distribution by Group",
        xlab = "Group",
        ylab = "Values",
        col = c("lightblue", "lightcoral", "lightgreen"),
        border = "black",
        lwd = 1.5)

# Panel 2: Group means with error bars
group_means <- aggregate(values ~ group, data = anova_data, FUN = mean)
group_sds <- aggregate(values ~ group, data = anova_data, FUN = sd)
group_ns <- aggregate(values ~ group, data = anova_data, FUN = length)
group_sems <- group_sds$values / sqrt(group_ns$values)  # Standard error of the mean

plot(1:3, group_means$values,
     main = "Group Means with Standard Error",
     xlab = "Group",
     ylab = "Mean Values",
     ylim = c(min(group_means$values - group_sems), max(group_means$values + group_sems)),
     pch = 19,
     cex = 1.5,
     col = c("blue", "red", "green"),
     xaxt = "n")
axis(1, at = 1:3, labels = c("Group A", "Group B", "Group C"))

# Add error bars (standard error)
for (i in 1:3) {
  segments(i, group_means$values[i] - group_sems[i], 
           i, group_means$values[i] + group_sems[i],
           lwd = 2, col = c("blue", "red", "green")[i])
  segments(i - 0.05, group_means$values[i] - group_sems[i],
           i + 0.05, group_means$values[i] - group_sems[i],
           lwd = 2, col = c("blue", "red", "green")[i])
  segments(i - 0.05, group_means$values[i] + group_sems[i],
           i + 0.05, group_means$values[i] + group_sems[i],
           lwd = 2, col = c("blue", "red", "green")[i])
}

# Reset plot layout
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "ANOVA Diagnostic Plots"
#| label: fig-anova-diagnostics

# Set up 2x2 panel layout for diagnostic plots
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

# Plot diagnostic plots from the ANOVA model
plot(anova_result)

# Reset plot layout
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
